reusable.what: SFZ-subset sampler for pinned CC0 libraries (VSCO 2 CE): regions, velocity layers, seeded round robins, Hermite resampling, leading-silence skip, per-instrument shift/retune fixes
Mastering chain in TypeScript: 28 Hz high-pass, glue compressor, BS.1770-4 meter, 4x-oversampled look-ahead true-peak limiter, iterated to a loudness target
Seeded synthesised Halloween foley: thunder, wind, gravel steps, wood knocks, creaks, iron clang, owl, bats, whooshes, paper, wax crack, stamp, a notification ding
A ribbed jack-o-lantern with a carved, glowing face and seeded flicker on twos

A storybook-night material family on MeshStandardMaterial: world-space paint breakup and brush streaks with fwidth-faded octaves, procedural bump (stone, bark, wood, iron), a capped moon rim light, painted ambient and aerial fog
A painterly generalised Kuwahara post effect (written from the published method) for the pmndrs postprocessing stack, its own PostChain stage
Centripetal Catmull-Rom splines with arc-length tables in 2D and 3D, for camera paths and walks that never overshoot
Stateless fractal value noise and ridged fields on the CPU for terrain, scatter and bark
Gnarled dead trees as one geometry from hand-drawn or grown skeletons (adapted from three.js's TreeGenerator, MIT)
Ragged, drooping low-poly conifers as one geometry with foliage normals and an ambient-occlusion vertex colour
Carved headstones, crosses and obelisks as signed distance fields meshed by surface nets: worn edges, chips, cracks, curvature per vertex
Seeded chiselled boulders, slabs and pebbles merged into one geometry with contact occlusion
Wrought iron as one geometry per builder: bent bars with rotation-minimising frames, lathe-turned parts, C and S scrollwork
Storybook roofs: overlapping tiles in wavy courses, ridge caps, iron cresting and finials
Ribbed, lopsided, warty pumpkins as a parametric surface carved through with exact polygon cuts (jack-o-lantern faces)
A bat from one outline spec, posed in 3D and drawn the same way in 2D: furry body, scalloped membrane wings
Torn orb cobwebs between anchor points, drawn as anti-aliased camera-facing thread ribbons
A hardcover book's parts as geometry: bevelled boards, a banded spine, a page block with leaf lines, a cover that hinges
